metaDescription: Kim Jong-suk, born 24 December 1917 in Hoeryong. Married to Kim Il-sung. Full biography, family, career and awards.
lead: Kim Jong-suk was a politician, born on 24 December 1917 in Hoeryong.
She died on 22 September 1949 in Pyongyang at the age of 31.
She has been recognised with Hero of the Republic and Order of the National Flag, 1st class.
Below you will find a verified overview of Kim Jong-suk: age, height, birthplace, family background, education, career milestones and awards, each drawn from open public records.

sections.heading: Kim Jong-suk — Family, Marriage and Personal Life
